ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the image is a schematic diagram of the scope of the Poyang Lake Ecological Economic Zone. It can be seen that this region is distributed around Poyang Lake. The map marks cities such as Jiujiang, Nanchang, and Yingtan, and labels “Poyang Lake Ecological Economic Zone”. Its location is within Jiangxi Province, near the Yangtze River but not the core developed urban agglomeration of the Yangtze River Delta. Then reason: the question requires comparing “with the Yangtze River Delta” in terms of the advantage in “labor prices”. The Yangtze River Delta is more economically developed, and wage levels and labor costs are higher; the Poyang Lake Ecological Economic Zone is located in the central inland region, and labor costs are relatively lower. Therefore, its advantage is low labor prices.
